extDescription.message: Reads the data of the WhatsApp Channels you administer from the open WhatsApp Web tab and sends it where you choose.

popupNote.message: The extension only reads what is already in the open WhatsApp Web. Open each channel once so its posts load; for insights, open the channel › Channel insights.

statusNoDestination.message: No destination — set a webhook in Settings.

errNoDestination.message: No destination set. Open the extension settings and add a webhook URL.

errNoWhatsAppTab.message: Open WhatsApp Web in a tab.

errReloadTab.message: Reload the WhatsApp Web tab (the extension was installed or updated after it was opened).

errNoChannels.message: No channel administered by this account was found.

errPageSilent.message: the page didn't answer (reload the WhatsApp Web tab)

optionsIntro.message: Each collection is sent as JSON (POST) to this URL. The extension asks for permission to reach it when you save.

invalidUrl.message: Use an https:// URL (http:// only for localhost).

permissionDenied.message: Permission to reach this URL was denied.

integrationActive.message: Delivery is handled by the built-in integration "$P1$"; the webhook below is not used.
